what_improved_and_why: The best custom CNN achieved validation macro-F1 of 0.6740. The frozen ResNet18 head achieved 0.8460, and full fine-tuning improved this to 0.9393. These results are consistent with useful pretrained features and further adaptation to flower images. The different model architectures also affect this comparison.
stability_and_limitations: Training and validation losses decreased overall. Both ResNet18 stages achieved their best validation macro-F1 at epoch 5, then declined slightly at epoch 6 while training loss continued falling. This suggests possible late overfitting. Only one seed was tested. The frozen head received six epochs, while the fine-tuned model received a cumulative twelve-epoch budget. ResNet18 also benefited from prior ImageNet training.
